dry_run.description: Whether to do a dry run

apikey_path_prefix.description: The instance specific AWS parameter path prefix for apikey

project_names.description: Comma-separated list of projects to search

modules.description: Comma-separated list of form modules to include

formver_split.description: Split output CSVs by form version (one file per module/formver, e.g. uds-v3.csv, uds-v4.csv). Each file has a column set restricted to that exact form version; rows are not column-unioned across versions.

output_file_prefix.description: Prefix for output file names. Output files are named {prefix}-{module}-{date}.csv (or {prefix}-{module}-{formver}-{date}.csv when formver_split is enabled).

batch_size.description: Number of NACCIDs per batch for OR-list queries (subject resolution and file queries)

reload_workers.description: Number of concurrent threads for reloading file metadata
